<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="PUT" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/settings/usage_widget"}
#docs
Replaces the list of origins (scheme, host and port, for example `https://app.example.com`) allowed to call the widget from a browser. https only; plain http is accepted only from a loopback origin, for local testing. A request from an origin that is not on the list gets no CORS grant, so the browser does not show the data. At most 20.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | The business's id (biz_…). |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `origins` | `array of string` | **yes** | The usage widget settings's origins. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `usage_widget_settings`. One of `usage_widget_settings`. |
| `origins` | `array of string` | The usage widget settings's origins. |
| `script_url` | `string` | Where the page loads `usage.js` from. Null when the API's public URL is not set. |
| `script_integrity` | `string` | The Subresource Integrity hash for the script tag's `integrity` attribute. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | The saved settings. |
| `400` | An origin is not valid. `param` names it. |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X PUT "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/settings/usage_widget" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "origins": [
      "Origin"
    ]
  }'
```
